title: Language Exchange
description: Ella Musk wants to find a group of hilichurls to practice her Hilichurlian. She claims to have a solid grasp of the basics, as well as plenty of communication experience... It's just that she's never had a chance to actually speak with them.

mainQuestExcel.description: Ella Musk wants to find a group of hilichurls to practice her Hilichurlian. She claims to have a solid grasp of the basics, as well as plenty of communication experience... It's just that she's never had a chance to actually speak with them.

dialogs.text: Traveler! Here! Over here!
Don't startle those hilichurls over there. Why are you always running off into hilichurl camps?
Forget it, it's not important. I've been researching Hilichurlian for some time, but I'd much rather get in some actual speaking practice than constantly going over books.
I've finally stumbled across a whole hilichurl camp... I cannot let this opportunity pass me by!
So, Traveler, can you go with me into the camp and help me find a hilichurl to practice with?

flow.stepDescription: Go to the hilichurl camp with Ella Musk

dialogs.text: Thankfully there's one awake right now.
This is him, let's go over and say hi.
Be careful though, it would be rude of us to wake the others.
We don't want them thinking we're storming into their camp to attack them.
There's absolutely no way they would talk to us then.

flow.stepDescription: Approach the hilichurl that is awake, but don't wake the others

dialogs.text: Be careful though, it would be rude of us to wake the others.
We don't want them thinking we're storming into their camp to attack them.
There's absolutely no way they would talk to us then.

flow.stepDescription: The hilichurls have been startled awake

dialogs.text: I said not to startle the other hilichurls! Have you really never tried to approach a hilichurl camp quietly!?
Ugh. There's no more hilichurls left at this camp. Such a great opportunity, completely wasted. All I can do now is wait until next time.
Oh shoot! They've all been woken up!

flow.stepDescription: Talk to the hilichurl with Ella Musk

dialogs.text: Olah! Muhe mimi, nye, eh... mosi aba?
Yo mimi beru si?
Buka...mita nye, guru-guru...yo mosi ka?
Ya odomu, Todo yo, buka guru-guru nye.
Mi? Dada! Valo.
Valo, ya odomu.
Hehe, look at how he's acting. He seems so happy!
Looks like this time has finally been a success, and my Hilichurlian has finally improved.

flow.stepDescription: Talk to the hilichurl with Ella Musk

dialogs.text: Biat ye, ye pupu dada mosi! Plama ye upa dada!
Dala beru yo!? Kundala muhe, kucha?
Kundala gusha! Hahaha!
Biat ye, plata ye pupu!
Movo unta nye kucha, mi dada tiga mitono!
Oh! I think he understood me! He seems to be taking out something to show us...
Oh, oh no! It's a weapon! Traveler, help me!
Good thing you were here, otherwise I would have no idea what would have happened to me.
I don't think I said anything wrong... Maybe my pronunciation was off...?
Guess I better hit the books again and do some more research before trying again...

What do you think? My Hilichurlian is not bad, huh? Now that we can communicate, all that's needed to understand each other is time.
That's what I hope for anyway. My dream, is to become friends with the hilichurls.
Oh, right! Before I forget — take this. It's a present from that hilichurl.
A present from a hilichurl. Bet you never thought you'd see the day!
Well I better get going, I have so many new discoveries to note down. Perhaps we'll have a chance to meet again.
Sure, let me go drag one out for you.
Wait! No! My word, just who exactly taught you to go bashing hilichurls around like that!?
Let's compose ourselves, go over there together, and politely introduce ourselves.
Perhaps it's better that you go alone.
That won't do! This is a rare opportunity. Even if you just want to slack off, I'm not letting you get off that easily!
